description: Fictional training-only vulnerability, not a published CVE: the lab relay fails to display a mismatch between the envelope sender and the reply-to address.
remediation: In the exercise, apply the lab relay's sender-consistency update and review messages delivered before the update.

description: Fictional training-only vulnerability, not a published CVE: the lab inspector evaluates the initial link but omits the final destination of a redirect chain.
remediation: Enable final-destination inspection in the lab build and rescan affected synthetic messages.

description: Fictional training-only vulnerability, not a published CVE: simulated account recovery does not invalidate the account's existing sessions.
remediation: Apply the exercise build that invalidates prior sessions and verify the approved recovery workflow with a synthetic account.

description: Fictional training-only vulnerability, not a published CVE: a lab backup operator role can modify recovery points intended to be immutable.
remediation: Apply the lab role-boundary fix, protect known-good recovery points, and test restore integrity before reconnecting recovered systems.

description: Fictional training-only vulnerability, not a published CVE: the lab endpoint watcher drops rapid file-rename events when its local queue reaches capacity.
remediation: Install the exercise queue-handling update and verify file-change telemetry against a synthetic rename workload.

description: Fictional training-only vulnerability, not a published CVE: a simulated read-only share group retains write access after a policy change.
remediation: Apply the lab permission-cache correction and verify effective access for synthetic service identities before restoring share connectivity.

description: Fictional training-only vulnerability, not a published CVE: the lab login gateway resets per-account rate counters when requests alternate between synthetic ingress nodes.
remediation: Deploy the exercise shared-counter update and validate rate limits across all lab ingress nodes using non-secret test inputs.

description: Fictional training-only vulnerability, not a published CVE: the lab identity console omits successful sign-ins from a mixed failed-and-successful authentication summary.
remediation: Apply the exercise aggregation correction and review raw authentication events for the affected synthetic accounts.

description: Fictional training-only vulnerability, not a published CVE: the lab edge router retains expired connection records until its request queue is exhausted.
remediation: Apply the exercise connection-expiry fix, enable the approved mitigation profile, and verify service health with synthetic traffic.

description: Fictional training-only vulnerability, not a published CVE: a lab route alias bypasses the route's intended request-rate limit.
remediation: Apply the exercise route-normalization update and confirm that the approved rate policy covers each synthetic route alias.

description: Fictional training-only vulnerability, not a published CVE: a lab deployment template restores a public-read grant after an operator removes it.
remediation: Correct the exercise deployment template, remove the unintended public grant through change control, and verify that redeployment keeps access private.

description: Fictional training-only vulnerability, not a published CVE: the lab object-audit collector omits anonymous reads from an exposure report.
remediation: Apply the exercise audit correction and compare the report with preserved access logs; record any remaining gaps in the exposure assessment.

description: Fictional training-only vulnerability, not a published CVE: the lab policy engine treats an unspecified principal as a public write grant.
remediation: Apply the exercise principal-validation fix and verify both denied anonymous writes and the intended private application access.

description: Fictional training-only vulnerability, not a published CVE: the lab sensor dashboard exposes a non-sensitive room label to another synthetic operator role.
remediation: Apply the exercise display-scope correction and refer the finding to the facilities application owner; no SOC playbook is linked.

description: Fictional training-only vulnerability, not a published CVE: a lab queue status endpoint reveals synthetic job titles across test operator groups.
remediation: Apply the exercise queue-visibility fix and request review from the application owner; no SOC containment procedure is inferred.
